zh.summary: 插件更新与兼容性提示现在更准确，也更容易采取正确动作。
highlights: 刚发布的插件更新会明确显示插件名和目标版本，并以安全确认提示呈现，不再伪装成全局错误。
仅有宿主版本范围不匹配时，诊断修复提示会优先更新到明确兼容当前 DSH 的插件版本，不再误导用户修改 bundle 顺序或 profile patch。
官网补充搜索引擎可读取的软件信息、站点地图和抓取规则，下载仍直接使用 GitHub Release。

en.summary: Plugin updates and compatibility guidance are now more precise and actionable.
highlights: Fresh plugin updates identify the package and target version in a safety confirmation instead of appearing as a global error.

When the only issue is a host-version range mismatch, the repair prompt now directs users to a plugin release that explicitly supports the current DSH version instead of suggesting bundle-order or profile-patch changes.
The website now exposes software metadata, a sitemap, and crawler guidance while keeping downloads on GitHub Releases.
